quarterly_data.signal: As of September 29, 2026, operating subsidiary ACM Research (Shanghai)'s total backlog amounted to RMB 17.1 billion (USD $2.5 billion, translated for reference), an 88.2% year-over-year increase compared with the prior year's disclosed backlog. The backlog includes orders for tools shipped but not yet recognized as revenue under Chinese GAAP and orders for tools expected to ship at a future date; the company notes backlog is not a GAAP measure and orders in backlog may not generate the estimated revenue.
